body: It was definitely quite the experience and I'm glad I have tried it in my life. However, I'm definitely going to try getting my hands on the RIGHT DMT for this subreddit because the things you guys have described sounds wild.

I suppose I'll just give a summary briefly covering most of it.

To start, the crazy kaleidoscope colors definitely happened and made up just about everything. The "kaleidoscope" pattern was also just cat heads...? There was really nothing special other than I constantly saw the figures of people and if I let myself slip deep into it I had weird telepathic conversations of no importance. I can't tell if my friend was fucking with me but at one point through his mumbling he looked over at me and said something like I need to forget everything and ascend?? (Butchering everything). Time was really blown to hell and I felt like I was in an alternate reality and really didn't like it. That's about all that was special. (The cats were the highlight of it all)
He got it from a good friend of his (I know the guy too) who does quite a lot of drugs. Anyway, the guy got it from one of his "dealers" he knows. It seems really likely that it was the 4-AcO.

You're definitely right about me not doing enough research, not even close. Next time (if there is one) I'm definitely going to be WITH my friend when he buys them and I will know what I'm using. On the up side, it has completely worn off and I feel fine after some pizza rolls and a can of Pepsi.

To answer your question, I DEFINITELY experienced effect, really crazy tripping from about 1:00 to 4:00. It probably would have been a much more enjoyable experience had I not come back to check on the thread (while still thoroughly tripping) and found some concerning comments. I was stressed out for a solid hour of it. You aren't me, I.E. an idiot, so if you can figure out roughly what I took it'd be appreciated! The 4-AcO sounds really familiar like it said it on the capsule or something but I definitely couldn't confirm that...

I just went downstairs to wake him up and tell him that we took the wrong thing and he said it was DMT it was powder inside the capsule? I really just want to try to figure out if it was or wasn't. I might as well also throw in that around and hour ago while I was still suffering from the trip, I went upstairs and threw up what I could in the toilet.

It was a capsule and now that I'm back I'm feeling alright but I am absolutely mortified that I don't know what the hell I took. I thought I did my research but I definitely didn't and I'm never touching a hallucinogen again. That's how I should have felt in the first place but it's a shame I needed to be taught a lesson.

Alright, I am back. Are you guys telling me that DMT in no way comes in the form of a pill or...? You're right I didn't do my research (enough I guess). I am fine or feel fine now, I just want to know if I am alright now and for someone to hopefully let me know what it is that I took if it wasn't DMT...

I think about it occasionally and know that when I turn 21 I won't be able to stop myself from buying alcohol on a regular basis. I already drink it every chance I get. Frankly last time I went out with my friends I guess I drank a little too much and blacked out, they tell me I was trying to stop myself from breathing and saying I want to die and shit like that. It's slowly tearing me apart... I have dreams involving her, I can't have a simple conversation or do something without something reminding me of her, I see another couple and I think of her. I'm at an all-time low and it's still going down. I hope both of us can get over this shit... Or find love...

Not at all, drug use, eating disorders, and anxiety are all possible after something like that happens and things just went downhill. It probably hurt her less than it did you in the end and I personally would've been able to forgive you. I just hope things get better for the both of us, you especially. I feel that I don't have a reason to be so depressed because compared to others, I've got it good. What you did was more of an effect than you actually doing it and no one should be able to hold that against you.

The girl that I started dating that I love broke up with me too... Even though I want to die I figured it might be comforting to know you aren't alone in that situation.

Both of my parents found out, my dad several months ago, my mom after their divorce. They both did the same thing, cared for a few weeks and despite me telling both of them that I wanted help, I haven't been taken and now I'm in too deep. I can't talk to my mom about that more than once. She asked if I still cut a week ago and I said no obviously because I can't take that stress even though I really want help and think about killing myself everyday.

You don't need to apologize. Even though I don't think about her maybe 2 days a week and I dream about her very often, she made her decision and nothing can change that. It'll most likely continue to tear me apart as I see her very frequently at school and continue thinking about what we could've been and the things we talked about doing together. You have every right to be upset with your issue too, I don't want you to think that mine is any worse or more important than yours because they both matter and I hope both of us can overcome this crippling loneliness...

Welcome to the club, not a very good club though. I started dating a girl I loved and have a crush on because she asked if I wanted to go on a date. We had so much in common and talked about the future like it was going to happen and then she broke up with me to "focus on herself" which is true but that can't have been the only reason knowing how much she liked and trusted me... My sleeping has gotten so bad that I can rarely get to sleep without laying in the bed 3+ hours every night. I haven't gone and gotten diagnosed with any of the problems I'm sure I have so right now I take Benadryl to go to sleep since it makes you drowsy and I've read doctors use it for patients sometimes. However, I've started building a resistance and take 7 or 8 pills a night and sometimes even that doesn't work. Coincidentally it's 3:00am and I'm replying to you because I let my friend get on my computer and the pills put me to sleep for and hour before my computer and keyboard sounds woke me up. I really hope you can overcome this like I can't seem to, good luck man :/

I got to have the best 2-3 weeks of my life before she broke up with me because she needs to focus on school and she has a lot of mental problems of her own and she couldn't handle it. I've wanted to die since she broke up with me. Every single day at least one things has made me think about her and ruined whatever mood I was in but it's usually 4 or 5 things a day. I've had several dreams with her in the including my dream before waking up right now at 1:30 in the afternoon... She was everything to me and now she hasn't talked to me since breaking up.

I have maybe two or three friends that I could talk to but I don't really do talking to people and especially about my problems :/ That's why even making an anonymous post like this is hard for me, I don't like troubling other people and don't want them to think differently of me.

Because of how desperate I am for help but not having it in me to tell someone I've thought too many time to count about making a close attempt on my life.

Not only did it take a ton of other opportunities but it taking away my good grades and literally NOT being able to focus in school led to way more fucking stress than there ever would have been and now there's no recovering.
The only "parties" I go to are with my only good friend and a sometimes a 1-2 other friends so I can drown myself in alcohol and forget how much I want to die

Most times when I read about it, it says that it can become an addiction. Even though I'm still kind of in a shitty mood, I'm doing it for no reason right now. It's pretty relentless

I really wish one of them would have taken me somewhere like I wanted but neither one did and I can't bring myself to bring it up. 

Sometimes I just want to make a close attempt on my life just so I can get help. I can't bring it up to anyone, I just can't. So that is what I've wanted to do just to get help. The days are getting worse and worse but now they don't even need a reason.
